description: Gaps left by earlier runs because source domains were blocked (all domains are allowed since 2026-11-09). Each research run takes the first country with open items, fills them on that country's branch (the open PR branch if not merged, otherwise a new claude/backfill-<iso3> branch from main), then marks the items done here in the same PR. 2026-11-10: second round for data older than 10 years (rule now enforced by validate.py).
